title: Personalized Baseball Coach Bucket Lid Pad, Laser Engraved EVA Foam Cushion, Softball Gift, Softball Gift, Yeti Bucket Lid Pad
description:
Personalized Baseball Coach Bucket Lid Pad, Laser Engraved EVA Foam Cushion, Softball Gift, Softball Gift, Yeti Bucket Lid Pad

Give your coach the "Best Seat in the House" 
Tired of seeing your coach sitting on a cold, hard plastic bucket during long practice sessions? Elevate their game-day experience with our Custom Laser Engraved Bucket Lid Pads. This isn't just a cushion; it’s a high-quality keepsake that ensures your coach’s ball bucket stands out in a crowded dugout and always makes its way home after the final out.

Perfect for end-of-season gifts, Coach Appreciation Week, or for that All-Star Baseball Mom or Dad who’s always at the field!

✨ Why This Pad is a Home Run:
Diamond-Tough Quality: Crafted from 1/4" thick, marine-grade high-density EVA foam. This is the same rugged material used on professional boat decks—engineered to handle intense sun, dirt, and the daily grind of a long season.

Precision Engraving: Each pad is personally designed and laser-engraved in our workshop. Unlike stickers or markers, our professional laser process creates a clean, permanent finish that won’t fade or peel.

📏 Perfect Fit for Every Team:
STANDARD SIZE (10.5"): Designed to fit standard 6-gallon ball buckets and most traditional lids.

YETI LOADOUT SIZE (12"): Specifically tailored for Yeti lids, including a precision cutout for the air vent.

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTE: This listing is for the customized foam pad only. The bucket and the plastic lid are NOT included.

🛠️ Pro-Tips for a Perfect Application:
The Clean Slate: For the best bond, ensure your bucket lid is 100% free of dirt, dust, or old adhesive before applying.

Warm Up for the Win: In colder months, EVA foam can become a bit stiff. We recommend keeping the pad indoors or near a safe heat source before application to make it pliable and ensure the adhesive sets perfectly.

 Turn Your MVP Into a Pro with a Custom Metal Football Trading Card!
Ever dreamed of seeing your kid, your coach, or even yourself on a professional-grade trading card? Skip the cardboard—our Custom Metal & Holographic Football Cards are the ultimate "Big League" upgrade for the gridiron.

Whether it’s a celebratory end-of-season gift, a senior night keepsake, or a unique way to honor a coach, these cards offer a pro-level shimmer that demands attention. Each card comes pre-protected in a Penny Sleeve and Top Loader, ready for the trophy shelf or the locker room.

✨ Why This Card is a Touchdown:
Pro-Level Finish: Printed on high-quality holographic material for that iconic "refractor" shine.

Fully Loaded Stats: Personalized with name, jersey number, team, position, and a custom "scouting report" on the back.

Name (First/Last)

Jersey Number

Team Name

Position (e.g., Quarterback, Wide Receiver, Linebacker)

Stats (Height/Weight)

Birth Date

Highlights: (List 2-4 fun facts, TDs, tackles, or "career highs" for the back!)

Color Request: (Optional: Let us know if you want to swap Red/Black for your team’s specific colors).

Please send your high-resolution photo(s) via Etsy Messages immediately after ordering.

1 Photo: We will use it for both the front and back.

2 Photos: We will use one for the front and one for the back (please label Front/Back).

Pro Tip: We may slightly adjust photos to ensure the holographic effect pops. Avoid heavy direct sunlight, as it can interfere with the metallic finish.

🎁 More Than Just Football

💍 Groomsmen/Bridesmaid Proposals ("The Starting Lineup")

🎂 Anniversaries & Best Friend Gifts
